svg.title: Madagascar interlock network
svg.text: 44 firms in 14 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 180 firms, 483 interlocks, 15 components (largest 136). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 64 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
